tasks.subject: Task 1: Hyperliquid agent API layer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add userRole/extraAgents clients, an agent->master resolver, and an extraAgents normalizer to hyperliquid.js, unit-tested via injected fetchImpl.

**Files:**
- Modify: hyperliquid.js (append after getUserFills, ~line 102)
- Test: test/hyperliquid.test.js (append)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- getUserRole/getExtraAgents POST the correct info body
- resolveAccountAddress returns master for role:agent, passes through other roles, falls back on malformed data or API failure
- normalizeExtraAgents flags expired and drops invalid-address rows

**Verify:** npm test -> all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["hyperliquid.js", "test/hyperliquid.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["getUserRole/getExtraAgents request bodies correct", "resolveAccountAddress agent->master + passthrough + fallbacks", "normalizeExtraAgents expired flag + filtering"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: DB via_agent column + migration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persist the agent address an account was reached through, with an idempotent migration for existing databases.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (SCHEMA, migration after db.exec, upsertWallet stmt+method, listWallets stmt)
- Test: test/db.test.js (append)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Fresh DBs include via_agent; pre-existing DBs gain it via ALTER TABLE without data loss
- upsertWallet(address,label,viaAgent) stores via_agent and preserves on null upsert
- listWallets() returns via_agent

**Verify:** npm test -> all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "test/db.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["migration adds via_agent to old DB", "upsert stores+preserves via_agent", "listWallets returns via_agent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Server routes + testability seam
tasks.description:
**Goal:** POST /api/wallets resolves entered address before saving and returns the resolution; add GET /api/agents/:address. Add a fetchImpl override seam to createApp.

**Files:**
- Modify: server.js (import, createApp signature + opts, POST /api/wallets, new GET route)
- Test: test/server.test.js (create)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- createApp(db,{fetchImpl}) threads fetchImpl into opts; createApp(db) unchanged in prod
- POST /api/wallets with agent saves master + returns resolved
- GET /api/agents returns normalized list; invalid->400; HL failure->502

**Verify:** npm test -> all pass (server.test.js uses app.listen(0) + injected fetch)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["server.js", "test/server.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["createApp overrides seam", "POST resolves agent->master + resolved payload", "GET /api/agents normalized + 400/502 handling"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Frontend badge + connected-agents panel
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Select the resolved master after adding, show a badge when viewing a via-agent wallet, render a connected-agents panel for the selected account.

**Files:**
- Modify: public/index.html (#walletBadge in <main>, agents panel after Open Positions)
- Modify: public/styles.css (badge + agent styles)
- Modify: public/app.js (short/esc helpers, walletMeta, renderWalletBadge, loadAgents, loadWallets, selectAddress, addBtn)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Adding an agent address selects the resolved master and shows the badge
- Via-agent wallet shows badge; normal wallet hides it
- Agents panel lists name/short-address/valid-until/expired with empty + soft-error states
- Agent names HTML-escaped

**Verify:** Manual: npm start; add 0x2ba553...061036 -> panel lists an agent; add no-agent account -> empty state; badge shows only for via-agent wallets

```json:metadata
{"files": ["public/index.html", "public/styles.css", "public/app.js"], "verifyCommand": "manual: npm start then verify badge + agents panel", "acceptanceCriteria": ["add agent selects master + badge", "badge only for via-agent wallets", "agents panel empty/list/error states", "agent names escaped"]}
```
